about.title: A spoonful of magic, made for pasta.
about.lead: Water, salt, pasta — and one spoonful of Pasta Magic. From the home kitchen to the Italian one.
about.statementTitle: So the Aglio e Olio you already make finishes with real aroma.
about.statementBody: Pasta Magic Powder is a seasoning made for dried pasta. Emulsify it with the cooking water, finish with olive oil, and the plate arrives fragrant and full of savour.

about.value3.title: Plainly explained

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: From what the product is to how to use and store it — the questions we are asked most.
faq.g1.title: About Pasta Magic Powder
faq.g1.q1: What kind of product is it?
faq.g1.a1: A pasta seasoning made for Aglio e Olio, combining dried garlic, chilli, parsley and basil.
faq.g1.a2: Garlic flakes, minced garlic, chilli, parsley, basil, salt and chicken consommé. Please always check the packaging before use.
faq.g1.a3: 5g of Pasta Magic Powder per 100g of pasta, for one serving. Adjust to taste.
faq.g2.title: Method and storage
faq.g2.a1: Boil 100g of pasta in 1L of water with 10g of salt, then combine 5g of Pasta Magic Powder with three tablespoons of the cooking water in a pan. Finish with 15g of extra virgin olive oil.
faq.g2.q2: Can I change the amount of salt?
faq.g2.a2: Yes, to taste. The product notes use 10g of salt per litre of water as the baseline.
faq.g2.a3: After use, seal the bag tightly and store away from direct sunlight, heat and humidity. Always follow the best-before date on the packaging.
